user.title: Box Zones
user.description:
Pick the trackers to follow, for example your car or phone. Each one gets a location entity that shows the name of the box it is in.

You can add more trackers later with **Add tracker** on this integration's page, or on the **Box Zones** page in the sidebar. Draw your boxes there too.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Box Zones is already set up. To follow another tracker, open Box Zones under Devices & services and press Add tracker.

user.title: Add tracker
user.description: Pick a tracker to follow. It gets a location entity that shows the name of the box it is in.

abort.not_a_tracker: Pick a device tracker. Box Zones' own location entities can't be followed.
